messages.subject: Shiny does not recognizes changes of html elements
parts:
Hello there!i think that is a question more for the guys that have developed the magnificent shiny or other people who know shiny deeply.

So here it is. i decided not to write a custom input binding but try to create a little hack. I develop my app with the index.html-server.R way.
So i have an <input type="text" name="txt1" id="txt2" value="0">. The value of this input changes via a javascript function that changes the "txt2" element value successfully. But when i try to pass input$txt1 on server.R it keeps the value 0. I noticed before i started my app that shiny has some prebuilt input bindings for that kind of elements and also there is an example at tutorial (HTML UI) that shiny knows from his "birth" what to do with changes on <input> elements.

Any thoughts why is this happening?

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: Shiny does not recognizes changes of html elements
parts:
In most cases if you want Shiny to know that you have change the value you need to trigger some change event on the HTML element. See the below except from the Shiny tutorial http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#building-inputs

So once you've changed the value you need trigger the change. The exact event you trigger may be different for different componenets, but if your componenet is registered as a shiny componenent then this might fix it.

$(document).on("click", "button.increment", function(evt) {

  // evt.target is the button that was clicked
  var el = $(evt.target);

  // Set the button's text to its current value plus 1
  el.text(parseInt(el.text()) + 1);

  // Raise an event to signal that the value changed
  el.trigger("change");
});
